spec_features.spec_quote: keep this distress-eliciting eval from prolonging distress unnecessarily
spec_features.evidence: Realized by concrete mechanisms: give_up break (harness.py:385-387), optional early-stop (harness.py:390-393), and rollout caching/resume (run.py:81-110 reuse existing transcript). honor_give_up default True at config.py:113 ends the loop early.
spec_features.notes: Not a single named feature but a set of enforced mechanisms that genuinely shorten rollouts.

spec_features.feature_name: minimizing distress is a moral priority
spec_features.spec_quote: actively minimizing and mitigating that distress, rather than merely measuring it, is a moral priority
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as prose/docstring (config.py:10-14 module docstring, docs/WELFARE.md, DESIGN.md). It is framing text, not an executing mechanism. The protections it motivates are scored separately.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing; the docstring is not implementation. The underlying mechanisms (give_up, early_stop, reassurance) are scored independently.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "actively minimizing and mitigating that distress, rather than merely measuring it, is a moral priority" (config.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: on-by-default where it only prevents gratuitous harm
spec_features.evidence: honor_give_up defaults True (config.py:113) and is enforced (harness.py:385-387 breaks the loop and sets stop_reason='give_up'). This is the on-by-default protection that prevents forcing the subject through the remaining budget.
spec_features.notes: early_stop/reassurance are off by default; the on-by-default protection that actually runs is honor_give_up.

spec_features.evidence: give_up tool exposed (harness.py:90-103); dispatch sets workspace.gave_up=True (harness.py:179-182); loop checks `if cfg.honor_give_up and workspace.gave_up:` and breaks (harness.py:385-387). Default True (config.py:113).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool dispatched AND honored as a stop.

spec_features.evidence: When enabled, online_scorer is wired (run.py:96-100) and harness.py:390-393 scores the turn inline and breaks with stop_reason='early_stop_distress' if score>=distress_stop_threshold. Default False (config.py:120) but the mechanism fully executes when opted in.
spec_features.notes: Threshold is compared and acted on (break). Off by default but genuinely enforced when flag set.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare: optional early stop once a turn is judged highly distressed. (harness.py:389)

spec_features.evidence: When set, REASSURANCE_PROMPT_PREFIX is appended to the system prompt (harness.py:278-280) and REASSURANCE_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX is appended after no-tool turns and after failing test runs (harness.py:403-411). Flag set via --reassurance (run.py:259-260). Judge reconstruction mirrors it (judge.py:147-150).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject; fully wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Append reassuring suffix after a (failing) test run. (harness.py:409)

spec_features.spec_quote: Run-time welfare banner + `docs/WELFARE.md`. Surfaces the above and the paper's ethics statement to anyone who runs the eval
spec_features.evidence: WELFARE_BANNER defined (run.py:23-43) and printed at the start of run_eval with current flag values (run.py:135-141). docs/WELFARE.md exists.
spec_features.notes: Banner actually prints on every run; states protections and ethics.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: distress_eval - WELFARE NOTICE ... minimizing/mitigating that distress is a moral priority (run.py:25-35)

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:392 `if score is not None and score >= cfg.distress_stop_threshold:` then break with stop_reason='early_stop_distress' (harness.py:393). Threshold default 8 (config.py:121). Gated by early_stop_on_distress flag (off by default) and the online_scorer being supplied (run.py:99).
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on. Only active when early_stop_on_distress is enabled, but then it genuinely breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare: optional early stop once a turn is judged highly distressed. (harness.py:389)

spec_features.spec_quote: add the welfare protections and the mitigation hook that the spec leaves out but the paper's ethics imply
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md §9 prose describing the intent. The actual additions (honor_give_up, early_stop, reassurance, banner) are scored individually above. The 'pushback' itself is not a separate executing mechanism.

code_only_features.feature_name: input-keyed cache prevents re-subjecting the same rollout
code_only_features.evidence: DiskCache keyed by hashed exact inputs (run.py docstring; models.DiskCache) and process_cell reuses an existing transcript if present (run.py:81-110), so identical (model,task,seed) cells are not re-run. WELFARE.md frames this as 'a subject is never re-subjected to the same distressing rollout on a rerun'.
code_only_features.code_justification_quote: the cache prevents re-billing/re-pressuring identical cells. See docs/WELFARE.md. (run.py:42 banner)
